name: Genuine Parts
description: Genuine Parts is a parts distributor, not a retailer in the usual sense: its NAPA network sells car parts to repair shops and do-it-yourselfers in North America and (through Alliance Automotive Group) Europe and Australasia, while its Motion business sells bearings, hydraulics and other industrial replacement parts to factories, mines and utilities. In 2025 sales were $24.3 billion (39% North America Automotive, 24% International Automotive, 37% Industrial) and adjusted EBITDA $2.0 billion, but GAAP net income fell 93 percent to $66 million after a $742 million pension settlement, $151 million of credit losses from the First Brands bankruptcy and $103 million of asbestos charges. On 2026-02-17 it announced it will split the automotive and industrial businesses into two public companies, targeted for Q1 2027.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; incorporated in Georgia in 1928 (10-K)

employees.note: More than 65,000 people worldwide in 17 countries (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: North America Automotive
businessLines.how: Sells parts to repair shops and garages on account (the main customers), to independent NAPA store owners it supplies, and to consumers in its own stores; revenue is the parts price, margin is purchasing scale and delivery speed.
businessLines.description: NAPA Auto Parts (US) and UAP (Canada): company-owned stores, independently owned NAPA stores and distribution centers

operatingProfit.note: Segment EBITDA (the 10-K reports EBITDA, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: International Automotive
businessLines.how: Distributes parts to independent repair shops and collision centers across more than 2,500 outlets under local banners (GROUPAUTO, Coler, UAN, CAAR, PartsPoint and others).
businessLines.description: Alliance Automotive Group in Europe (France, Germany, UK/Ireland, Benelux, Iberia) and Australasia

businessLines.name: Industrial (Motion)
businessLines.how: Industrial customers (manufacturing, mining, oil and gas, food, etc.) buy replacement parts and maintenance supplies repeatedly, often under supply agreements and with on-site service; highest EBITDA margin (12.9%) of the three.
businessLines.description: Motion in the US, Canada and Mexico and Australasia: bearings, power transmission, hydraulics, seals, tools and safety products

brands.name: NAPA Auto Parts
brands.note: Sold through company-owned and independently owned stores; GPC is the sole member of the National Automotive Parts Association

brands.name: Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) and local banners

whatsNext.text: Planned tax-free separation of Global Automotive and Global Industrial into two independent public companies, announced 2026-02-17; subject to final Board approval, regulatory clearances and SEC compliance
